Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.integration.messaging

Class KfeRemoteFinancialNotificationClient

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.integration.messaging.KfeRemoteFinancialNotificationClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.kerosene.common.financial.notification.FinancialNotificationPort
@Component @Profile("kfe") @ConditionalOnProperty(name="kfe.remote.notifications.enabled", havingValue="true", matchIfMissing=true) public class KfeRemoteFinancialNotificationClient extends Object implements com.kerosene.common.financial.notification.FinancialNotificationPort
Sends internal KFE payment and deposit events to the core service's notification API.

    • notifyDepositConfirmed

      public void notifyDepositConfirmed(Long userId, UUID transactionId, UUID walletId, String rail, long creditedSats, int confirmations)
      Notifies the user that an inbound deposit reached its credited confirmation state. Delivery is best-effort after request construction; network and remote response errors are logged.
      Specified by:
      notifyDepositConfirmed in interface com.kerosene.common.financial.notification.FinancialNotificationPort
      Parameters:
      userId - credited account owner
      transactionId - ledger transaction associated with the deposit
      walletId - receiving wallet
      rail - deposit rail, such as on-chain or Lightning
      creditedSats - amount credited in satoshis
      confirmations - observed confirmation count
